department: Department of Biological Sciences (Klein College of Science)

deadline.value: Fall deadline is January 15 (for full financial consideration); spring deadline is October 1, and most admissions are for Fall.
deadline.quote: Deadlines for applications are January 15 for the Fall semester and October 1 for the Spring semester

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

gre_general.value: New applicants need no GRE scores; the checklist lists them as optional.

also.quote: (Optional) Official GRE scores (verbal, quantitative, and analytical)

supervisor.value: At least one faculty member must agree to be the tentative major advisor before admission is final.
supervisor.quote: At least one Graduate Faculty member must indicate an interest in serving as the student’s tentative major advisor

funding.value: Teaching assistantships are competitive, and research assistantships are highly competitive.
funding.quote: A TA in the Department of Biological Sciences is a competitive award

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree from an accredited university is the entry requirement.
entry_route.quote: a B.S. or B.A. degree from an accredited university

toefl_min.value: The department's TOEFL line (83, 220 or 557, and a preferred 100) is on the old scale, so no current TOEFL minimum is recorded.

ielts_min.value: The department requires an overall IELTS band of 6.5 for applicants whose native language is not English.
ielts_min.quote: a minimum overall band score of 6.5 on the IELTS

fee_waiver.value: The department says it has no process to waive the Graduate School application fee.
fee_waiver.quote: The Department of Biological Sciences does not have a process to provide waivers for application fees required by the Graduate School

notes: The Bioinformatics and Computational Biology PhD (College of Computing and Informatics) is a separate program: GRE general is required but waivable with a qualifying GPA; deadlines January 1 (Fall) and September 1 (Spring); English test required unless the degree is from an English-speaking country. It is not saved because the field can hold one program record.
